newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sri Lanka tenders to sell Jul 18-19 light naphtha.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka tenders to sell Jul 18-19 light naphtha.

text.p: Sri Lanka's state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to sell 125,000 barrels of light naphtha for July 18-19 lifting, free-on-board (fob) Colombo basis, a CPC official said on Wednesday.
The tender closes on July 2 and bids will be valid for two days.
In its last tender, CPC sold 110,000-125,000 barrels of light naphtha to Swiss trader Glencore at $1.23 per barrel discount to Singapore spot quotes, for May 2-3 lifting, fob Colombo.
